title: EchoLLaMA: 3D-to-Speech with Multimodal AI
content: We present a 3D-to-Speech model that transforms 3D images into spoken descriptions. Our approach integrates four models: DETR and Moondream for image analysis, LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct (trained with DPO) for generating textual descriptions, and Orpheus-3B-0.1-ft TTS model that we fine-tuned for speech synthesis. The training data for LLaMA were generated using the DeepSeek-V3-0324 model and the base model itself for the DPO Reinforcement Learning technique. In addition, users can interact with the system by asking LLaMA questions via speech input, allowing a dynamic and conversational experience.
